Hey SOR family!


I've started planning our August showcase for our adult bands and wanted to see if you'd like to make it a party, and have multiple all together?! We are planning to host this on August 1st at 1886 Humble Backyard in Humble, TX. 


I know Calvin is hosting a House Band show this day as well, but I wanted to create a cool opportunity for your adult bands, and this date happened to work for most of our bands. 


The last combined adult showcase was a blast. Everyone seemed to have a great time, many approached us saying how much fun they had and expressed interest in doing more, so here we are, creating another one!


We will hire a sound team and photographers, and we will have vendors and other fun activities. To cover some of these costs, we will charge a $50 signup fee per school. If this is something you're not able to do, just reach out to me directly to let me know; we don't want to leave anyone out! 


Since this is an outdoor venue (where we hosted Backyard Fest), the plan is to hold the event in the evening. Depending on the number of bands, I can give you a more realistic time window. Let me know if your school is interested and available, and we can start cooking on this!! 


August 1st @ 1886 Humble Backyard


Thanks so much in advance,


--

Rad Fest Scavenger Hunt Challenge! 

Hello! I am super excited to post the thread for our School of Rock Rad Fest Scavenger Hunt. Each house band will be asked to compete with other schools in completing the most challenges between each other. We will be awarding the school with the most points a special prize for their efforts as well as the bragging rights of being Radfest's first annual scavenger hunt CHAMPION. Do your best to represent your school and bring this title of honor to yourselves.

All of these prompts are picture / video friendly challenges that must be submitted under this band thread. We're looking forward to seeing all of your submissions. Please submit all picture and videos here by Nov 22nd 11:59pm.

We are looking forward to seeing all of your picture and video submissions. Please feel free to share these prompts on your social medias. Each post with the tag #Radfest2025 and tagging @SchoolofRock + @Yourlocalschoolofrockinstagram will be awarded 2 additional points per post. Good luck House Band!


Take a group selfie with a different School of Rock Houseband (10 points)
Take a Picture wearing merch from a Local Band (10 points)
Show us your best mosh pit moves during a set (10 points)
Create the shape of a number 6 and 7 with another Houseband member of a differnet school than yours (20 points)

Trade a guitar pick with someone from a different school (10 points)

Interview a Local Houston Artist and what they love about the Houston Music Scene (Major Prize! Bonus amount of points! Will be dertermined by quality of video)

Interview Another HB Student and tell us what they love about School of Rock. (Major Prize! Bonus amount of points! Will be dertermined by quality of video. Both recording and interviewed school will be awarded points. Opportunity for scoring points twice!)

Interview a School of Rock Staff Member and what they love about working for School of Rock (Major Prize! Bonus amount of points! Will be dertermined by quality of video.)

Picture with a Houston Artist (10 points)

Hello School of Rock Fam!


We're coming up on the final push for Radfest! I've got some great info for you here and want to be sure that you all know what's coming! 


In this email: 

Radfest Team and Owner's/GMs Meeting - Thursday, November 20th at 12pm
SoR Musician's Packet and Run of Show
Day of Show Camp Sale Discount!
Your ticket sales/giveaways Will Call list
Final push for promotions!
Lead Capture and Recruiting at Radfest
Please join us for our final info call prior to Radfest! 
Houston Wide RadFest Call, Thursday, November 20 · 12:00 – 1:00pm
We ask that at least one festival attending representative from each school join this meeting as well as the owner or general manager. Please RSVP to the calendar invite set to you. 


School of Rock Musician's Packet
Run of Show
It's all the info you'll ever want on parking, show times, our final promo push, and the official run of show! 


Day of Show Camp Sale Discount
We're offering a special PRE-Black Friday Camp Sale discount for anyone attending Radfest. It is your choice to participate - we have included a "participating locations" caveat on the collateral. Using coupon code RADFEST25, camps will be discounted 25%. To be sure that this does not interfere with the upcoming Black Friday sale, you must set up your coupon in Pike13 with an expiration date of 11/27/2025. 


Your Individual School Ticket Sales
Please submit your ticket sales names for Will Call no later than Thursday, November 20th. Email your ticket names to Luke at lshiflet@schoolofrock.com. If you have another form of ticket that you have used, we must verify this prior to the day of show. We don't want someone to not get in because we don't recognize the ticket being submitted! 


Final Promotions!
Get on those socials and promote Radfest! Have your House Band members film stories and reels and tag #axelrad, #schoolofrock and #radfest2025! 



Our social media pages: 
Instagram Page: https://www.instagram.com/radfest2025?igsh=bzg0dW5hNWl2YjA3
Facebook Event Page: https://facebook.com/events/s/radfest/721137540929490/


Feel free to steal and share all things Radfest! Several promos filmed by Luke have gone viral and could generate more buzz with reshares! Shout out to West U for CRUSHING the social media promos!


Let's BLOW THIS THING UP THIS WEEK!


On Site Lead Capture and Recruiting
We have a system for Lead Capture and Instructor Recruiting we will be implementing at the merch/info table! We'll have an iPad ready and waiting on the School of Rock home site for lead capture so any leads gathered for your territory will be sent directly to you from the School of Rock home page!


We'll also be gathering leads through our guitar giveaway - folks who sign up will choose the school in their area to drop their names in the drum! We'll gather those and disperse them post event. 


Additionally, with all of these local musicians running around, we'll be recruiting for you as well! We want you to have a full staff of qualified musicians to build your school, our city and our brand and what better way to meet them than at an event that features our students! 


So that about wraps it up! Get on the socials and promote and be sure to attend our Radfest School of Rock meeting next Thursday at noon!


Your School of Rock Radfest Team

HOWDY, FOLKS! JUST WANTED TO RESEND AN EMAIL THAT WAS SENT A COUPLE OF WEEKS BACK REGARDING OUR CURRENT CANCELLATION/HOLD POLICIES. SEE BELOW FOR ORIGINAL EMAIL.

 

Good afternoon, West U Cru! As we start to look forward to our Summer programs, we wanted to send out an email to everyone containing some reminders/updates regarding our cancellation, hold, and make-up lesson policies. This way, everyone is clear on what to expect in the event you need to pause your plan for the Summer.

 

If you need to pause your plan during the Summer, you have two options.

 

Option 1: You can pause your plan for a period of 1 full month, beginning with the 1st day of your chosen month. Unfortunately, we can no longer do plan holds for a period longer than 1 month.

 

Option 2: If you are going to be gone for longer than 1 month, then you will need to cancel your plan entirely. Don't worry, you will not be charged a signup fee when you rejoin School of Rock! However, we do have a 30-day cancellation policy, meaning your account expires 30 days from when you give notice of cancellation. Please plan accordingly if you know that you will be gone for longer than 1 month.

 

Also, please note that you cannot use make-up lessons if you are on hold or have cancelled your membership. Students must have an active membership to use any make-up lessons that they may have accrued.

 

Thanks, everyone. We hope that all of this is clear. Please call or email us with any questions. In the meantime, see below for a quick reminder on what we are offering in Performance Program this upcoming Summer season. Rock 101 will also have a new slate of material, so don't miss out on what is sure to be an amazing season!

Hello SoR W. University Place friends!  Keep Music Alive would like to invite SoR West University Place to participate in the MILESTONE 10th Annual Kids Music Day this October.  Suggested events or promotions you can offer to your community include: musical instrument petting zoos, student performances (in-house or out in the community), musical performances for children, instrument donation drives, kids open-mics, drum (ukulele or guitar) circles, open houses, bring-a-friend to class/lesson, fundraisers for your favorite child-centered music non-profit, free intro lessons (individual or group) and Kids Music Day Sales on select instruments, accessories, lesson & program packages and special discounted ticket pricing for children’s events.  If you already have something planned, chances are it can be included.  If you have another idea, please let us know, we’d love to hear about it.

Your Kids Music Day event or promotion can be held anytime between Friday, September 26th through Sunday, October 12th and can be any type of event or promotion that benefits or celebrates children playing, enjoying or being a part of the music.  As always, there are NO FEES to participate.  All participating locations will have their logo, website link, address, phone number and event listed on the Kids Music Day site for a full year, beginning in mid-September (searchable by zip/postal code or city and state/province).  In addition, we will be reaching out to print, radio, TV and online news sources in all major media markets where Kids Music Day events are taking place, to encourage them to spread the word and bring more students and customers to your door. We’ll also be running a paid social media campaign to help draw more attention to participating locations.  Media coverage we’ve received previously includes Entertainment Tonight, Good Morning America, People TV, Good Day New York, local ABC, NBC, CBS & FOX affiliates in multiple states and national Elvis Duran Morning Show.

We are pleased to announce that, once again, 12-year-old Sabrina Patel will be our Official Spokesperson this year.  Sabrina is on a quest to play the National Anthem on the violin at major sports events in all 50 states (MLB, NBA, NASCAR, etc.) and has already performed in nearly 34 states with multiple events in numerous states.

We are also delighted to welcome back and have the continued support of these stellar Kids Music Day Ambassadors:  Julie Andrews, Jack Black, Sarah McLachlan, Pat Benatar & Neil Giraldo, Damien Escobar, Richie Sambora, Bernie Williams, Ann & Nancy Wilson of Heart, Vanessa Williams, Kenny Loggins, Victor Wooten, Michael Feinstein, Todd Rundgren, Mandy Harvey and Philip Lawrence.

Please let us know if you would like to join over 1,200 participating locations around the world celebrating the 10th Annual Kids Music Day in October.  You DO NOT have to decide what type of event or promotion you would like to hold at this time... simply reply back with YES to let us know you would like to participate and we'll follow up at a later time for the details.  Please feel free to share this invitation with others you think may be interested.  If you have any questions, or need additional information, please let us know.  Thank you for your time and all you do to educate and inspire young music makers in our world!


Musically yours,

The last combined adult showcase was a blast. Everyone seemed to have a great time, many approached us saying how much fun they had and expressed interest in doing more, so here we are, creating another one!


We will hire a sound team and photographers, and we will have vendors and other fun activities. To cover some of these costs, we will charge a $50 signup fee per school. If this is something you're not able to do, just reach out to me directly to let me know; we don't want to leave anyone out! 


Since this is an outdoor venue (where we hosted Backyard Fest), the plan is to hold the event in the evening. Depending on the number of bands, I can give you a more realistic time window. Let me know if your school is interested and available, and we can start cooking on this!! 


August 1st @ 1886 Humble Backyard


Thanks so much in advance,


--

HOWDY, FOLKS! JUST WANTED TO RESEND AN EMAIL THAT WAS SENT A COUPLE OF WEEKS BACK REGARDING OUR CURRENT CANCELLATION/HOLD POLICIES. SEE BELOW FOR ORIGINAL EMAIL.

 

Good afternoon, West U Cru! As we start to look forward to our Summer programs, we wanted to send out an email to everyone containing some reminders/updates regarding our cancellation, hold, and make-up lesson policies. This way, everyone is clear on what to expect in the event you need to pause your plan for the Summer.

 

If you need to pause your plan during the Summer, you have two options.

 

Option 1: You can pause your plan for a period of 1 full month, beginning with the 1st day of your chosen month. Unfortunately, we can no longer do plan holds for a period longer than 1 month.

 

Option 2: If you are going to be gone for longer than 1 month, then you will need to cancel your plan entirely. Don't worry, you will not be charged a signup fee when you rejoin School of Rock! However, we do have a 30-day cancellation policy, meaning your account expires 30 days from when you give notice of cancellation. Please plan accordingly if you know that you will be gone for longer than 1 month.

 

Also, please note that you cannot use make-up lessons if you are on hold or have cancelled your membership. Students must have an active membership to use any make-up lessons that they may have accrued.

 

Thanks, everyone. We hope that all of this is clear. Please call or email us with any questions. In the meantime, see below for a quick reminder on what we are offering in Performance Program this upcoming Summer season. Rock 101 will also have a new slate of material, so don't miss out on what is sure to be an amazing season!

Hi everyone! 


Here are the questions for the scavenger hunt mentioned at the meeting. If you missed, I'm encouraging all House Bands to participate in a photo/video scavenger hunt to help create bonding, meet new people across our different schools, and also help each school have social media content for them to use as they would like. This is the draft post I created and posting on our band page. This was an incredibly fun activity created by Kris K on the Gulfshores All-Star team and hoping it brings our kids together and encourages them to stay for a longer duration of the event. Have your students upload their videos to your HB Band page, and please please encourage them to post them on socials and use the #Radfest2025 and tag @schoolofrock plus @ your local social media page as well. I'll share our doc to keep track of points of our own school (honor code system) and we can pick a 3rd party to determine our major point giveaway tasks. Let me know how I can help or clarify anything needed. Thanks! 


https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QUYd0xnIbilocNkOLk6uCIUlm2uwAqgwBK_y_nhnMWo/edit?usp=sharing
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Rad Fest Scavenger Hunt Challenge! 

Hello! I am super excited to post the thread for our School of Rock Rad Fest Scavenger Hunt. Each house band will be asked to compete with other schools in completing the most challenges between each other. We will be awarding the school with the most points a special prize for their efforts as well as the bragging rights of being Radfest's first annual scavenger hunt CHAMPION. Do your best to represent your school and bring this title of honor to yourselves.

All of these prompts are picture / video friendly challenges that must be submitted under this band thread. We're looking forward to seeing all of your submissions. Please submit all picture and videos here by Nov 22nd 11:59pm.

We are looking forward to seeing all of your picture and video submissions. Please feel free to share these prompts on your social medias. Each post with the tag #Radfest2025 and tagging @SchoolofRock + @Yourlocalschoolofrockinstagram will be awarded 2 additional points per post. Good luck House Band!


Take a group selfie with a different School of Rock Houseband (10 points)
Take a Picture wearing merch from a Local Band (10 points)
Show us your best mosh pit moves during a set (10 points)
Create the shape of a number 6 and 7 with another Houseband member of a differnet school than yours (20 points)
Clips from 3 different School of Rock House Band Sets (15 points)
Clips form 3 different Houston artist (15 Points)
Trade a guitar pick with someone from a different school (10 points)
Write a 15 secind jingle about Radfest (15 points)

Interview a Local Houston Artist and what they love about the Houston Music Scene (Major Prize! Bonus amount of points! Will be dertermined by quality of video)

Interview Another HB Student and tell us what they love about School of Rock. (Major Prize! Bonus amount of points! Will be dertermined by quality of video. Both recording and interviewed school will be awarded points. Opportunity for scoring points twice!)

Interview a School of Rock Staff Member and what they love about working for School of Rock (Major Prize! Bonus amount of points! Will be dertermined by quality of video.)

Picture with a SOR staff member (10 points)
Picture with a Houston Artist (10 points)
Picture with a Houston Band (Full Band) (15 points)
Take a 20+ person group photo (20 points)
best Air drum solo Video (5 points)
Best Air guitar Video (5 points)
best Air bass slap Video (5 points)
best metal scream (5 points)
take a .5 (5 points)
Give positive affirmations to at least 4 people (single video take) (15 points)
Sing a Song with a Stranger (15 points)
Sing a Harmony with someone outside your group (5 points)
High Five a Stranger (5 points)
Silly Picture Pose with School of Rock Logo Present (10 points)
Make a Unique Handshake (5 points)
Best K-Pop Group Pic (10+ people) (20 points)
Find a picture of a "Weird" Object (5 Points)
Convince a stranger to sing the chorus of a rock song with you (video) (15 Points)

Hello School of Rock Fam!


We're coming up on the final push for Radfest! I've got some great info for you here and want to be sure that you all know what's coming! 


In this email: 

Radfest Team and Owner's/GMs Meeting - Thursday, November 20th at 12pm
SoR Musician's Packet and Run of Show
Day of Show Camp Sale Discount!
Your ticket sales/giveaways Will Call list
Final push for promotions!
Lead Capture and Recruiting at Radfest
Please join us for our final info call prior to Radfest! 
Houston Wide RadFest Call, Thursday, November 20 · 12:00 – 1:00pm
We ask that at least one festival attending representative from each school join this meeting as well as the owner or general manager. Please RSVP to the calendar invite set to you. 


School of Rock Musician's Packet
Run of Show
It's all the info you'll ever want on parking, show times, our final promo push, and the official run of show! 


Day of Show Camp Sale Discount
We're offering a special PRE-Black Friday Camp Sale discount for anyone attending Radfest. It is your choice to participate - we have included a "participating locations" caveat on the collateral. Using coupon code RADFEST25, camps will be discounted 25%. To be sure that this does not interfere with the upcoming Black Friday sale, you must set up your coupon in Pike13 with an expiration date of 11/27/2025. 


Your Individual School Ticket Sales
Please submit your ticket sales names for Will Call no later than Thursday, November 20th. Email your ticket names to Luke at lshiflet@schoolofrock.com. If you have another form of ticket that you have used, we must verify this prior to the day of show. We don't want someone to not get in because we don't recognize the ticket being submitted! 


Final Promotions!
Get on those socials and promote Radfest! Have your House Band members film stories and reels and tag #axelrad, #schoolofrock and #radfest2025! 



Our social media pages: 
Instagram Page: https://www.instagram.com/radfest2025?igsh=bzg0dW5hNWl2YjA3
Facebook Event Page: https://facebook.com/events/s/radfest/721137540929490/


Feel free to steal and share all things Radfest! Several promos filmed by Luke have gone viral and could generate more buzz with reshares! Shout out to West U for CRUSHING the social media promos!


Let's BLOW THIS THING UP THIS WEEK!


On Site Lead Capture and Recruiting
We have a system for Lead Capture and Instructor Recruiting we will be implementing at the merch/info table! We'll have an iPad ready and waiting on the School of Rock home site for lead capture so any leads gathered for your territory will be sent directly to you from the School of Rock home page!


We'll also be gathering leads through our guitar giveaway - folks who sign up will choose the school in their area to drop their names in the drum! We'll gather those and disperse them post event. 


Additionally, with all of these local musicians running around, we'll be recruiting for you as well! We want you to have a full staff of qualified musicians to build your school, our city and our brand and what better way to meet them than at an event that features our students! 


So that about wraps it up! Get on the socials and promote and be sure to attend our Radfest School of Rock meeting next Thursday at noon!


Your School of Rock Radfest Team

Hey all!


If you're receiving this email, that means we haven't yet received your school's house band setlist submission yet for Radfest. Since we're only a few weeks out from the big day, we need to get these from you ASAP! Here's a link to the submission form.


Please keep in mind that, much like Summerfest and similar multi-school events, this is a "no-repeats" show, with songs approved on a first come, first served basis. This means that if a song has already been claimed by another house band, you'll be asked to substitute it for something else, so the sooner we get your songs, the more time your band has to pivot if need be! I'm going to include a list below of songs that have already been claimed at the time of writing this email just to potentially save you guys some headache time, though of course by the time you receive this more may have been submitted.


Runtime is also a factor in approval of these setlists. The allotted 25 minutes is a hard-stop, and includes any transition time between songs; official instruction to the sound guy is to cut sound right at the 25 minute mark if a band starts to go over, so please keep this in mind when choosing your songs as we would absolutely hate to see any groups have their sets cut like that. When in doubt, better to have a slightly shorter set than to cut it too close!


Feel free to reach out with any additional questions or concerns, but beyond that please have your setlists submitted via the Google Form by this Friday (10/31). We're looking forward to having you guys be a part of this milestone event!


Songs claimed thus far:

Mr Crowley (Ozzy Osbourne)

Lovefool (The Cardigans)

Impossible Germany (Wilco)

Oye Mi Amor (Mana)

Square Hammer (Ghost)

Barracuda (Heart)

Welcome to Paradise (Green Day)

Supermassive Black Hole (Muse)

I Will Survive (Gloria Gaynor)

Born to Be Wild (Steppenwolf)

Fortunate Son (CCR)

Black Hearted Woman (Allman Brothers)

Rolling in the Deep (Adele)

Heartbreaker (Pat Benatar)

Killing in the Name (RATM)

Come As You Are (Nirvana)

Birds of a Feather (Billie Eilish)

Everlong (Foo Fighters)

Misery Business (Paramore)

Hypnotize (System of a Down)

Linger (The Cranberries)

Freaking Out the Neighborhood (Mac Demarco)

Weird Fishes (Radiohead)

So Sick (Flyleaf)

Bat Country (Avenged Sevenfold)

Into the Void (Black Sabbath)



Mason Burt
Music Director, School of Rock Katy


(281)769-7010  |  www.schoolofrock.com/katy




mburt@schoolofrock.com

Hey SOR family!


I've started planning our August showcase for our adult bands and wanted to see if you'd like to make it a party, and have multiple all together?! We are planning to host this on August 1st at 1886 Humble Backyard in Humble, TX. 


I know Calvin is hosting a House Band show this day as well, but I wanted to create a cool opportunity for your adult bands, and this date happened to work for most of our bands. 


The last combined adult showcase was a blast. Everyone seemed to have a great time, many approached us saying how much fun they had and expressed interest in doing more, so here we are, creating another one!


We will hire a sound team and photographers, and we will have vendors and other fun activities. To cover some of these costs, we will charge a $50 signup fee per school. If this is something you're not able to do, just reach out to me directly to let me know; we don't want to leave anyone out! 


Since this is an outdoor venue (where we hosted Backyard Fest), the plan is to hold the event in the evening. Depending on the number of bands, I can give you a more realistic time window. Let me know if your school is interested and available, and we can start cooking on this!! 


August 1st @ 1886 Humble Backyard

Hello School of Rock Fam!


We're coming up on the final push for Radfest! I've got some great info for you here and want to be sure that you all know what's coming! 


In this email: 

Radfest Team and Owner's/GMs Meeting - Thursday, November 20th at 12pm
SoR Musician's Packet and Run of Show
Day of Show Camp Sale Discount!
Your ticket sales/giveaways Will Call list
Final push for promotions!
Lead Capture and Recruiting at Radfest
Please join us for our final info call prior to Radfest! 
Houston Wide RadFest Call, Thursday, November 20 · 12:00 – 1:00pm
We ask that at least one festival attending representative from each school join this meeting as well as the owner or general manager. Please RSVP to the calendar invite set to you. 


School of Rock Musician's Packet
Run of Show
It's all the info you'll ever want on parking, show times, our final promo push, and the official run of show! 


Day of Show Camp Sale Discount
We're offering a special PRE-Black Friday Camp Sale discount for anyone attending Radfest. It is your choice to participate - we have included a "participating locations" caveat on the collateral. Using coupon code RADFEST25, camps will be discounted 25%. To be sure that this does not interfere with the upcoming Black Friday sale, you must set up your coupon in Pike13 with an expiration date of 11/27/2025. 


Your Individual School Ticket Sales
Please submit your ticket sales names for Will Call no later than Thursday, November 20th. Email your ticket names to Luke at lshiflet@schoolofrock.com. If you have another form of ticket that you have used, we must verify this prior to the day of show. We don't want someone to not get in because we don't recognize the ticket being submitted! 


Final Promotions!
Get on those socials and promote Radfest! Have your House Band members film stories and reels and tag #axelrad, #schoolofrock and #radfest2025! 



Our social media pages: 
Instagram Page: https://www.instagram.com/radfest2025?igsh=bzg0dW5hNWl2YjA3
Facebook Event Page: https://facebook.com/events/s/radfest/721137540929490/


Feel free to steal and share all things Radfest! Several promos filmed by Luke have gone viral and could generate more buzz with reshares! Shout out to West U for CRUSHING the social media promos!


Let's BLOW THIS THING UP THIS WEEK!


On Site Lead Capture and Recruiting
We have a system for Lead Capture and Instructor Recruiting we will be implementing at the merch/info table! We'll have an iPad ready and waiting on the School of Rock home site for lead capture so any leads gathered for your territory will be sent directly to you from the School of Rock home page!


We'll also be gathering leads through our guitar giveaway - folks who sign up will choose the school in their area to drop their names in the drum! We'll gather those and disperse them post event. 


Additionally, with all of these local musicians running around, we'll be recruiting for you as well! We want you to have a full staff of qualified musicians to build your school, our city and our brand and what better way to meet them than at an event that features our students! 


So that about wraps it up! Get on the socials and promote and be sure to attend our Radfest School of Rock meeting next Thursday at noon!


Your School of Rock Radfest Team

Hi Everybody,


We know that with the summer coming up a number of our families have some big vacations planned. Below are a few options of how your student can stay involved at School of Rock, even if their summer schedule is a little crazy. 


1.) Online Lessons


If your student will be travelling a lot this summer, there is the option for them to do a weekly virtual lesson during their regular one on one time. With the School of Rock online app, your student can continue progressing on their instrument even if they are away!


2.) Holding Your Students Enrollment


There is also the option to put your students' enrollment on hold with us for up to 2 months. Holding your student's enrollment will keep you in the loop with the upcoming Fall season, and makes the process of getting added back to the schedule extremely easy.


If you would like to put your students' enrollment on hold, please fill out the form linked below.


Hold Enrollment Form





3.) Attending a Summer Camp 


If your student will only be gone for one month, you have the option to keep their enrollment active and receive a free summer camp voucher. This option also reserves the one on one lesson time that your student currently has booked. 


If would like to take advantage of any of these options, please feel free to email us at westu@schoolofrock.com or call us at (832)-900-7625


Thanks!




- Calvin

HOWDY, FOLKS! JUST WANTED TO RESEND AN EMAIL THAT WAS SENT A COUPLE OF WEEKS BACK REGARDING OUR CURRENT CANCELLATION/HOLD POLICIES. SEE BELOW FOR ORIGINAL EMAIL.

 

Good afternoon, West U Cru! As we start to look forward to our Summer programs, we wanted to send out an email to everyone containing some reminders/updates regarding our cancellation, hold, and make-up lesson policies. This way, everyone is clear on what to expect in the event you need to pause your plan for the Summer.

 

If you need to pause your plan during the Summer, you have two options.

 

Option 1: You can pause your plan for a period of 1 full month, beginning with the 1st day of your chosen month. Unfortunately, we can no longer do plan holds for a period longer than 1 month.

 

Option 2: If you are going to be gone for longer than 1 month, then you will need to cancel your plan entirely. Don't worry, you will not be charged a signup fee when you rejoin School of Rock! However, we do have a 30-day cancellation policy, meaning your account expires 30 days from when you give notice of cancellation. Please plan accordingly if you know that you will be gone for longer than 1 month.

 

Also, please note that you cannot use make-up lessons if you are on hold or have cancelled your membership. Students must have an active membership to use any make-up lessons that they may have accrued.

 

Thanks, everyone. We hope that all of this is clear. Please call or email us with any questions. In the meantime, see below for a quick reminder on what we are offering in Performance Program this upcoming Summer season. Rock 101 will also have a new slate of material, so don't miss out on what is sure to be an amazing season!

Our Summer Season is Only 2 Weeks Away!

 

We had yet another EPIC End of Season showcase last Saturday! I want to thank all of the musicians, parents, and staff that came together for an awesome afternoon of music and community.

 

With that being said, we are gearing up for our next performance season, which will begin the week of June 2nd.

 

For the next two weeks, our regular rehearsal schedule will take a slight detour. 

 

This week, we will be having workshops during our regular rehearsal times. These workshops are open to any performance student. Rock 101, Little Wing, and Rookies rehearsals will remain the same this week. The upcoming workshops are:

 

Improvising 101 (Tuesday 5:00 - 7:00 w/Logan)

Songwriting 101 (Tuesday 7:00 - 9:00 w/Joy)

Rhythm Masterclass (Wednesday 6:30 - 8:30 w/Matt)

Maintaining and Fixing Gear (Thursday 6:00 - 8:00 w/Zach)

The Art of Performing (Friday 6:00 - 8:00 w/Calvin)

 

Each workshop will have a 20 student capacity. Students will automatically be enrolled into the workshop that will happen during their regular rehearsal time. If your student would like to attend another workshop, please contact the school at (832)-900-7625. Students are allowed to attend multiple workshops at no extra cost if it is not already at capacity! 

 

Next week, we will be having a "prep week" where the school will be closed for training, deep cleaning, and planning for the summer season. We will not be issuing make-up passes for lessons and rehearsals cancelled during prep week.

 

Last Minute Sign Ups For The Summer Season
 
While our official sign up form is no longer live, we are still accepting last minute sign ups for our Summer performance season. Please contact the school at (832)-900-7625 if you are interested in signing up for one of our performance groups. Please note that you may not get your first choice because the majority of our students have already been assigned to a group.
Sign Up For a Summer Camp

 

There is more than one way to rock out this summer at School of Rock. If you have a crazy traveling schedule and are hesitant to commit to a full season then please consider checking out one of our summer camps. We have camp options for students of all ages and experience levels. For more info about our summer camps click the button below!

 

 

 

 

Summer Camps at School of Rock West U!
